source_snapshot.test_name_items: Check LAN during LAN wire unplug and replug
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Under SOL session, unplug LAN wire and check LAN is workable after LAN wire replugs.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. BMC LAN should be workable after LAN wire replugs.
2. SOL terminal should be connected after LAN wire replugs.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: under an active SOL session the operator physically unplugs the LAN cable, then replugs it and expects BMC LAN + SOL to recover. Physically unplugging/replugging the LAN cable and confirming the physical link is human work; agent cannot touch the RJ45 cable.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator unplugs/replugs the BMC LAN cable in an active SOL session and confirms the LAN + SOL reconnect; agent cannot handle the physical cable but could report BMC reachability afterwards.

original_test_intent: Verify an active BMC SOL session is interrupted by physical link loss and that the same BMC LAN and SOL service recover after the cable is replugged.
original_method: An engineer unplugs/replugs the identified cable while network/SOL state and timing are recorded.
manual_activity: Physical cable handling and link confirmation are core engineer actions; the agent can only poll BMC/SOL and collect timestamps/logs.
safety_requirements: Verify exact labeled cable and avoid production network disruption.
Do not simulate the source action with software interface-down unless approved as different coverage.
Protect SOL credentials and session logs.
No automatic retry; stop on connector or network damage.
agent_execution_scope: Maintain probes, timestamp disconnect/reconnect, validate BMC identity and SOL recovery after engineer actions.
Do not touch cable or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Unplug/replug correct cable and confirm physical link.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly identifies physical boundary and permissible supporting evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep manual cable method; use automated identity-safe network/SOL polling.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Active SOL, physical unplug/replug, LAN/SOL recovery and 10/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Establish SOL and independent probes, record engineer cable removal/reinsertion, measure link/BMC/SOL recovery and verify the original endpoint/session behavior.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact path identity and latency evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not replace physical link loss.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong cable can disrupt another device or management path.

project_override_considerations: A switch-port shutdown is different coverage unless explicitly approved and recorded; it cannot silently claim physical connector recovery.
expected_evidence: Port/path identity and active SOL baseline

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria align on physical link-loss recovery; missing timeout/path are inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation is clear and manually executable; physical core makes it MANUAL ONLY rather than BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Distinguishes physical connector recovery from software link toggling and captures SOL session semantics.
independent_technical_reasoning: The connector, PHY and switch link path are part of the function under test; software-only disconnect cannot prove mechanical replug/link negotiation, so engineer action is essential.
